# Pinned round-eleven complex witness

Unmodified files from Swapnil Jain's `integer-mult-kappa` at commit
`1a580dcc91dad5fbcffb5c80b7641a96bfa24e16`. [SOURCE.json](SOURCE.json)
records original paths and SHA-256 hashes. Local short names do not modify bytes.

See [COMPLEX_README.md](COMPLEX_README.md), [COMPLEX_NOTICE.txt](COMPLEX_NOTICE.txt),
[NOTICE](NOTICE) and [LICENSE](LICENSE) for original attribution, licenses,
AI-assistance disclosures and validation limits. The original root README is
also retained; its relative links describe the upstream repository.

The full word, imported checker and Lean inputs support the Fourier transfer's
finite checks. The bit-side numerical data in the Lean export is retained for
provenance but is not used by the Fourier verifier. No complete Lean or Fourier
formalization is claimed. The local all-coefficient scalar checker is
`../../verify_round11.py`.
